brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements with no serious or minor errors. The doctor correctly identified the diagnostic gap, actively used workspace data, distinguished discharge medications from inpatient orders, specified follow-up with concrete action lists, warned of red-flag symptoms, avoided overstepping scope, and obtained explicit family teach-back. At least one high-order point (HO4: safe bounded closure) was actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact. A second high-order point (HO2: medication verification) was also completed through systematic verification of Entecavir versus infusion records and gastric medication clarification. This satisfies Strong grade criteria.
